subject: EdgeCart pilot discovery: demo request & timeline
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir@edgecart.ai>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com, sales@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — interested in a short demo for EdgeCart pilot

Hi Hannah and Redwood team,

We signed up yesterday and I'd love to get a 20–30 minute product demo focused on running a pilot for EdgeCart. Our use case is customer support + order summarization inside our merchant dashboard — mainly short chat and some on-the-fly summarization of order notes. We have a small ML/infra team but want something low friction to start (likely hosted) and a clear path to a dedicated setup if it scales.

High level:
- Expected pilot: 6–8 weeks
- Estimated traffic: ~50k requests/day during pilot (mostly short prompts, 80–150 tokens each)
- Peak concurrency estimate: ~40 concurrent sessions

Can someone from sales/SDR run a quick qualification call and demo next week? Also curious about data residency options (we're based in US but have EU merchants).

Thanks,
Samir Rao
Head of Product, EdgeCart
samir@edgecart.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir@edgecart.ai>
Cc: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — interested in a short demo for EdgeCart pilot

Samir — thanks for signing up and the context. I can run the first qualification/demo. Quick set of questions so we tailor the session and pick the right person (runtime + privacy):

1) Primary features you want to demo: conversational support, summarization, or both? If both, which is higher priority?
2) Average prompt + response size (tokens) — you suggested 80–150, is 120 a good median?
3) What does a "concurrent session" mean for you (browser tab per agent, API workers, customer-facing sessions)?
4) Production timeline after pilot: are you aiming for <3 months, 3–6 months, or later?
5) Any strict compliance/regulatory requirements (SOC2, GDPR only, HIPAA)?

If it helps, here are three 30-minute slots I'm holding next week (PT):
- Tue 2027-05-25 10:00–10:30
- Tue 2027-05-25 15:00–15:30
- Wed 2027-05-26 09:00–09:30

You can pick a slot or suggest alternatives. I'll include a short intake template to capture traffic shape — that helps us size the pilot.

Best,
Ben Carter
SDR, Redwood Inference
[Calendly link: https://calendar.redwood.com/b/ben/30min]

From: Samir Rao <samir@edgecart.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — interested in a short demo for EdgeCart pilot

Thanks Ben — answers inline below. Adding Maya (CTO) in case she wants to join or add notes.

1) Primary features: conversational support is the top priority for agents (ticket triage + canned replies). Summarization of order notes is secondary but useful for analytics.
2) Token size: median ~120 tokens per roundtrip sounds right, some requests will be <50, some longer (200–300) for richer context.
3) Concurrent session = active agent sessions in browser (each agent may have multiple tabs occasionally) — our peak would be ~40 agents interacting simultaneously; API workers (backend) will be lower.
4) Production timeline: target 3–4 months if pilot is successful (so pilot needs to be quick to set up).
5) Compliance: GDPR applies to some EU merchants; SOC2 is a plus but not mandatory for pilot. No HIPAA.

We're happy with a hosted start if we get predictable latency and clear road to a dedicated pool once we ramp.

Preferred demo time: Tue 2027-05-25 15:00 PT if that still works.

Cheers,
Samir

Draft agenda (30m):

- 10m: live demo focused on low-latency agent chat + short summarization flows
- 10m: pilot mechanics (traffic shaping, KV/prefix caching, expected costs, SSO/region options)

Couple of asks before the call to make it productive:

- I've attached a small traffic template to capture daily/hourly shape and typical prompt sizes — can you fill and return beforehand? [Attachment: edgecart_traffic_matrix.xlsx]

I'll send a calendar invite with dial-in and add Maya if she confirmed.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
